description: [DREAL OCCITANIE] Réseau de chaleur en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Occitanie. Heat network from 2017 data from the Statistical Service of the Ministries of Housing, Transport, Energy, Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development (SOES). They have been geolocated to the centroid of municipalities that have a network of this type. It is therefore not a precise location of these facilities. Coverage: DREAL Occitanie. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL OCCITANIA] Heat network in Occitanie" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Occitanie. Its keywords include public, donnees-ouvertes, dreal, inspire, sources-denergie, occitanie. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2019-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
